requirements.name: parser-architecture
requirements.text: CommonMark parsing is two phases: resolve **block structure** first, then run **inline parsing** over the block contents. Implement in that order.

requirements.name: parse-blocks
requirements.text: 1. Blocks: paragraphs, thematic breaks, ATX headings, setext headings, indented code, fenced code, HTML blocks, link reference definitions, block quotes, then lists — lists are the hardest block construct, with lazy continuation, nesting, and tightness.

requirements.name: parse-inlines
requirements.text: 2. Inlines: backslash escapes, entity and numeric references, code spans, emphasis and strong emphasis (the delimiter-run algorithm), links and images, autolinks, raw HTML, hard breaks.

requirements.name: pipe-through-program
requirements.text:
def pipe_through_prog(prog, text):
    p1 = Popen(prog.split(), stdout=PIPE, stdin=PIPE, stderr=PIPE)
    [result, err] = p1.communicate(input=text.encode('utf-8'))
    return [p1.returncode, result, err]
